question: The area of a square is 4096 sq cm. Find the ratio of the breadth and the length of a rectangle whose length is twice the side of the square and breadth is 24 cm less than the side of the square.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the square = √4096 = 64 cm

Length of the rectangle (L) = 64 × 2 = 128 cm

Breadth of the rectangle (B) = 64 − 24 = 40 cm

Required Ratio (B : L) = 40 : 128 = 5 : 16

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of the square = 4096 cm²

Length of the rectangle = 2 × Side of the square

Breadth of the rectangle = Side of the square − 24 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of a square = a² (where a is the side of the square)

 
 
 Side = 64 cm
 Square
 Area = 4096
 
 
 
• 
 

 
 
 
 L = 128 cm
 B = 40 cm
 Rectangle

 
 Ratio (B : L) = 40 : 128 = 5 : 16

**Calculation:**

⇒ a² = 4096

⇒ a = √4096 = 64 cm

⇒ Length of the rectangle (L) = 2 × 64 = 128 cm

⇒ Breadth of the rectangle (B) = 64 − 24 = 40 cm

⇒ Ratio of Breadth to Length = 40 : 128

⇒ Dividing both sides of the ratio by their highest common factor (8)

⇒ Ratio = 5 : 16

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Square

All four sides are equal and each angle measures 90°. Formulas: Area = side² and Perimeter = 4 × side.

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, with each angle measuring 90°. Formulas: Area = L × B and Perimeter = 2 × (L + B).

Diagonal Formulas

For a square: Diagonal = side × √2. For a rectangle: Diagonal = √(L² + B²).
